title: Immersive horror? Count me in to Jill’s Tupperware Party at @Underbel...
transcript: The key to a good Edinburgh Fringe show is a really good elevator pitch. And I will say I have not wanted to see a show as fast as I did in hearing that Jill's Tupperware Party was an interactive horror show. And y'all, they, they delivered that tenfold in Jill's Tupperware Party. Your name is now Jill, and you are invited to the latest party to celebrate all of the Tupperware sales for some of the greatest dishware found in a kitchen. Jill's Tupperware Party is delightfully weird and bizarre. if you're looking for something a little offbeat this French season, I cannot recommend it enough. Though do be aware you will be on your feet for this one. It is standing room only, and you are moving throughout the venue. It is playing at the Underbelly Cowgate venue through the rest of the month.
classificationReason: Review of an Edinburgh Fringe immersive horror show at Underbelly Cowgate. Not in the provided list of Broadway/West End/Off-Broadway productions.
